commands.label: Run IDE command
commands.description: Opens the IDE's command search so you can run any IDE command by name.
examples: SPC f a, type wrap → pick the soft-wrap toggle
commands.rationale: Conventions disagree (VSpaceCode SPC SPC, Doom Emacs SPC :, LazyVim SPC s C), so the key follows IntelliJ's Find Action: a for action.
